title: HED process catalog
description: Schema for data/process_details.json, the catalog of cognitive processes published by hed-task. Shape only; cross-checks (count headers, unique ids, category ids resolve, tasks[] agrees with task records) run in src/generate_docs.py.

process_count.description: Number of processes whose primary category this is.

categories.description: The categories this process belongs to: exactly one primary (where it is filed) and any number of secondary cross-listings.

tasks.description: Derived from task_details.json by sync_process_details_tasks.py - do not hand-edit.

name.description: Alias text. Used as both an S2 sub-query string and as a phrase-gate substring filter - keep specific enough to avoid noise.

reference.description: Bibliographic reference. Identifier fields (DOI / PMID / PMCID / OpenAlex / S2 / ArXiv) are grouped under a nested 'ids' block. The 'url' field stays at the top level - it's a location, not an identifier. 'pub_id' is the content-addressed cross-repo key (built from lastname + year + title via identity.build_pub_id); it stays at the top level too because it's not an external handle.

id_set.description: Nested block of external identifiers for a publication. Shape mirrors opencite's IDSet to keep cross-tool interop trivial. All fields optional; missing values are null. additionalProperties:false to catch typos in hand-edits.

oa_status.description: Open-access status enum following OpenAlex's vocabulary, plus 'unknown' for refs not yet enriched. Distinct from 'is_oa' (a boolean) because 'bronze' (free-to-read but no open licence) is not redistributable and must not collapse into the same bucket as 'gold' (CC-BY hosted by publisher).

pdf_location.description: A single known PDF location for this publication. Shape mirrors opencite's PDFLocation. License is a normalised SPDX-style string (see code/literature_search/license_policy.py); version is OpenAlex's publishedVersion/acceptedVersion/submittedVersion enum.

source.description: Where this URL came from. Free-form to allow new sources without schema bumps; conventional values: openalex, s2, unpaywall, pmc, biorxiv, medrxiv, arxiv, doi, elsevier_api, wiley_tdm, springer_api, manual_library.

version.description: publishedVersion / acceptedVersion / submittedVersion (OpenAlex vocabulary), or null if unknown.

license.description: SPDX-style normalised licence (cc-by, cc-by-sa, cc-by-nc, cc-by-nc-sa, cc-by-nd, cc-by-nc-nd, cc0, public-domain, proprietary, unknown). See license_policy.normalise_license. null is allowed during partial enrichment but discouraged after; prefer 'unknown'.

local_artifacts.description: On-disk artifacts (PDF and/or Markdown) acquired for this publication. PDF and Markdown carry independent licences because they may come from different source URLs (e.g. publisher PDF via library + CC-BY Markdown via PMC BioC). Optional; absent until something has been acquired.

local_artifact_entry.description: One on-disk artifact OR a failure-record placeholder. Two shapes share the same slot: (1) Success: 'path' is a non-empty workspace-relative string (e.g. 'HED-PDFs/Smith_2008_x_abc12345.pdf'); 'source_type' and 'license' are required. is_publishable is a cached derivation of license; downstream tooling MUST recompute rather than trust a stale stored value, so it is optional here. (2) Failure: 'path' is null and 'last_attempt' is required, accompanied by 'attempts', 'tried', and 'reason' so the auto-acquisition orchestrator can record that we tried and nothing landed. The if/then/else clause below enforces the two shapes.

path.description: Workspace-relative artifact path, or null on a recorded failure.

source_type.description: How this artifact was obtained. Conventional values: auto_openalex, auto_unpaywall, auto_s2, auto_pmc_bioc, manual_library, manual_conversion, pmc_bioc, markitdown, mistral. Free-form to allow future sources.

acquired_via.description: auto | manual | null (legacy). Indicates whether the artifact was acquired by an automated script or by a curator action.

converter.description: Markdown only. Identifies which converter produced the file: pmc_bioc, markitdown, mistral, manual.

is_publishable.description: Cached value of license_policy.is_publishable(license). Optional; downstream tooling should recompute rather than trust this.

last_attempt.description: Failure record only. ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent acquisition attempt.

attempts.description: Failure record only. Cumulative attempt count across re-runs.

tried.description: Failure record only. Source tags (e.g. 'openalex', 'unpaywall', 'pmc') visited on the most recent attempt.

reason.description: Failure record only. Human-readable summary of why nothing landed.

category_membership.description: One category membership. Exactly one membership per record has role 'primary' (where the record is filed; the category page holds its full entry); the rest are 'secondary' cross-listings. confidence 'review' flags a judgement call for a second opinion: on the primary, 'not sure this is the right home'; on a secondary, 'not sure this belongs here at all'. rationale is required on a secondary and on any review entry (cross-checks in src/generate_docs.py).

category_id.description: Must exist in the categories array.
